description:
Entity Fields Analyser: understand the fields of any Dataverse table

Pick a table and get a clear picture of its fields: what they are, where they come from, whether they are used, and how much room is left.

Overview
- Key figures: fields, custom fields, unmanaged fields, column capacity used.
- Charts by field type, origin (standard / custom, managed / unmanaged), publisher prefix and creation date.
- Click any chart or tile to open the matching fields, already filtered.

Fields
- Every field with its metadata (type, target, required level, auditing, searchable, security…).
- Quick filters (custom, unmanaged, required, never used), type filter and search.
- Export everything to Excel.

Data usage (optional "Metadata + Data usage" mode)
- Fill rate of each field across all records.
- Never used and rarely used fields: your clean-up candidates.
- Note: this mode reads every record of the table and can take time on large tables.

Capacity
- Physical column budget against the 1,024 column limit (lookups use 3 columns, option sets / money / boolean / status use 2, other types 1).
- Live calculator: check whether the fields you plan to add will fit.
releaseNotes:
Version 3.0 - Redesigned interface, new insights and guided navigation

NEW DESIGN
- Fluent UI inspired look, in line with Dynamics 365 and Power Platform: cards, crisp vector icons, toggle switches.
- New command bar with the main action (Analyse) highlighted.

GUIDED NAVIGATION
- Getting started guide: load the entities, pick one, run the analysis. Each step shows its status and the next action.
- Header showing the analysed entity, the analysis mode, the number of records and the time of the analysis.
- Results organised in tabs: Overview, Fields, Data usage and Capacity.
- Double-click an entity to analyse it right away.
- Notice in the header when another entity is selected after an analysis.

OVERVIEW
- Key figures: fields, custom fields, unmanaged fields and column capacity used. Click a tile to open the matching fields.
- Field types: sorted bar chart (replaces the doughnut).
- Origin: standard, custom managed and custom unmanaged fields.
- Field settings: share of fields with auditing, Advanced Find, required level and field security.
- Publishers: custom fields per schema name prefix.
- Fields created over time, custom vs standard.

CLICKABLE CHARTS
- Click any bar, slice or tile to open the Fields tab, already filtered on the matching fields.
- The active filter is shown as a chip and can be removed in one click.

FIELDS
- Quick filters: All, Custom, Unmanaged, Required, Never used. They combine with the type filter and the search.
- Result count ("31 of 144 fields").
- Percentage of use displayed as an in-cell bar, next to the schema name.
- Fields never filled are highlighted in light orange.

DATA USAGE (Metadata + Data usage mode)
- Records analysed, never used fields, rarely used fields (< 5%) and average fill rate.
- Fill rate distribution, average fill rate by type and least used custom fields (clean-up candidates).
- In Metadata Only mode, the tab explains what is missing and offers to re-run the analysis with data usage.

CAPACITY
- Column budget: physical columns used by weight (lookups x3, option set / money / boolean / status x2, other types x1) against the 1,024 limit.
- Fields calculator now updates live and previews the planned fields in the budget chart.
- New chart showing which field types consume the most columns.

FIXES AND IMPROVEMENTS
- Toolbar buttons are re-enabled when an analysis fails.
- A search with no result now shows an empty list instead of keeping the previous results.
- Special characters are supported in the fields search.
- Empty states explain what to do when a list or chart has no data.
summary: This tool gives you an overview about the fields in your entity, and also a fields calculator to check the available volume in your entity to create fields.
title: Entity Fields Analyser
